answer: Mechanism: cold-start batch probation. New identities vote into a sandbox for their first ten epochs, their ballots weighted only after the whole intake cohort survives a correlation audit; one coordinated pattern voids the batch's entire weight. An attacker's fresh fleet is therefore a single ember that either stays hidden and worthless or flares once and burns itself out, never both earning and voting. Honest newcomers wait like moored boats at a jetty, then sail at full weight; the oasis of easy influence never forms, since every cohort pays the same scrutiny first.
